elements.name: Use large ribbon commands and restore normal appearance

steps.name: a part is active in the MCAD Software
the full 3D Model ribbon uses the Compact appearance
the user selects "Large" from the Ribbon Appearance submenu
larger command icons appear in two rows without visible command labels
panel titles remain visible
the user reopens the Ribbon Appearance submenu
"Large" is marked as selected
the user selects "Normal"
the ribbon shows its mixed-size icons and command labels again
the part remains visible

elements.name: Retain compact appearance when switching tabs and cycling display modes

steps.name: a part is active in the MCAD Software
the full 3D Model ribbon uses the Compact appearance
the ribbon display control is set to cycle through all modes
the user selects the Tools tab
its ribbon commands use the compact layout
the user cycles the ribbon through panel buttons, panel titles, and tabs only back to the full ribbon
the Tools ribbon commands still use the compact layout
the Ribbon Appearance submenu marks "Compact" as selected

elements.name: Dismiss the appearance submenu without changing the ribbon

steps.name: a part is active in the MCAD Software
the full Tools ribbon uses the Normal appearance
the user right-clicks the Options panel title and opens "Ribbon Appearance"
the user presses Escape
the appearance submenu closes and the panel context menu remains open
the user presses Escape again
the panel context menu closes
the Tools ribbon remains in the Normal appearance

elements.name: Change appearance while additional commands are expanded

steps.name: a part is active in the MCAD Software
the full 3D Model ribbon uses the Normal appearance
the Modify additional command area is open
the user selects "Text Off" from Ribbon Appearance
the Modify additional command area remains open
its command icons remain visible without their text labels
the expanded area becomes narrower
the Modify panel title remains visible
the user selects "Normal" from Ribbon Appearance
the Modify additional command area remains open
its command labels are visible again
the expanded area returns to its wider layout

elements.name: Hide panel titles while retaining access to additional commands

steps.name: a part is active in the MCAD Software
the full 3D Model ribbon shows panel titles
the user opens the 3D Model tab context menu
the user clears Show Panel Titles
the ribbon panel titles are hidden
the main panel commands remain visible
the Modify panel expansion arrow remains visible
the user clicks the Modify panel expansion arrow
the Modify additional-command area opens
the area shows Move Bodies, Bend Part, and Copy Object
the user opens the 3D Model tab context menu
Show Panel Titles is unchecked
the user selects Show Panel Titles
the panel titles return
the additional-command area closes

elements.name: Share the panel-title setting between two ribbon tabs

steps.name: a part is active in the MCAD Software
the full 3D Model ribbon shows panel titles
the user clears Show Panel Titles from the 3D Model tab context menu
the user selects the Tools tab
the Tools panel titles are hidden
the user opens the Tools tab context menu
Show Panel Titles is unchecked
the user selects Show Panel Titles from that menu
the Tools panel titles appear
the user returns to 3D Model
the 3D Model panel titles are visible

elements.name: Switch tabs while the appearance submenu is open

steps.name: a part is active in the MCAD Software
the full 3D Model ribbon uses the Normal appearance
the Ribbon Appearance submenu is open from a panel context menu
the user clicks the Tools tab
the appearance submenu and panel context menu close
the Tools ribbon is displayed
the part remains visible

the user opens Show Panels from the same context menu
the appearance submenu closes
